title: VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training
grouping: One left-to-right row without containers: input clip -> masked 3-D grid -> visible tokens -> green Encoder -> latent cubes -> column of latent plus mask cubes -> blue Decoder -> reconstructed cubes -> target clip. Small captions in plain sans sit under each stage (Downsampled video clip, Tube masking with an extremely high ratio, Tokens w/o [M], Target video clip); a two-entry legend (blue cube = keeping, grey cube = masking) sits under the masking stage.
shapes_depth: Video clips are offset stacks of four photo frames, each with a thin 'Time' arrow drawn above it. The masking stage is a wireframe 3-D volume of four frame slabs cut into a grid: most cells grey, a few showing photo patches or tinted red, with a translucent blue tube running through time. Tokens are small 3-D cubes - photo-faced for visible tokens, translucent green after the encoder, grey for mask tokens, light blue after the decoder. Encoder and decoder are plain rounded rectangles, green and blue.
proposed_highlight: The masking idea is carried by the data, not by a highlighted box: the grid shows most cells grey and the token column after the encoder is mostly grey mask cubes with a few green ones, so the masking ratio is visible as a count.
lesson: Put a small 'Time' arrow over every frame stack and draw tokens as small 3-D cubes whose colour tracks their state (visible, encoded, masked, decoded), so the masking ratio is visible in the token counts on either side of the encoder.
notes: Venue NeurIPS 2022 read on the PDF first page.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
